title: 15-State ES-EKF vs Legacy 9-State EKF Forensic Root-Cause Investigation
verdict: ROOT CAUSES IDENTIFIED — GRAVITY LEAKAGE & WARMUP GATING LOCKOUT EXPLAIN EMPIRICAL DIVERGENCE

root_causes.name: Pre-Blackout GNSS Gating Lockout
root_causes.mechanism: update_gnss_pos used hard Chi2 gate threshold (11.345). Position offsets during warmup exceeded gate, causing 100% rejection of GPS position fixes and starting blackouts with 300m-2100m initial position error.

root_causes.name: 3D Gravity Leakage in Strapdown Mechanization
root_causes.mechanism: In 3D ES-EKF, specific force subtraction a_nav = R(q) f_b + g_nav couples roll/pitch attitude errors into horizontal acceleration. A 5-degree tilt error produces 0.85 m/s^2 horizontal acceleration, integrating into 1,539m position drift in 60s. The 2D legacy planar EKF does not integrate 3D gravity, making it immune to tilt-induced gravity leakage.

root_causes.name: NHC Attitude Cross-Coupling during Cornering
root_causes.mechanism: NHC observation Jacobian H[0, 8] = -v_bx couples lateral velocity innovation into yaw error. At 15 m/s, lateral tire slip or centripetal acceleration injects false yaw rotations, destabilizing the heading.

root_causes.name: Centripetal Apparent Tilt during Turns
root_causes.mechanism: During turns at 10 m/s with 0.5 rad/s yaw rate, centripetal acceleration (5.0 m/s^2) creates a 27-degree apparent gravity tilt. Dynamic leveling against raw specific force causes roll/pitch runaway to 60-90 degrees.

pure_60s_turn_speed_10mps_omega_0_1radps.conclusion: ES-EKF math and Jacobians are bitwise exact under ideal synthetic IMU inputs.

drive_m_60s_turning.primary_divergence_cause: Roll/pitch tilt divergence (-67.3 deg roll, +52.5 deg pitch) rotating gravity into horizontal acceleration.

drive_y1_60s_straight.primary_divergence_cause: Warmup GNSS gating lockout and open-loop gyro bias integration.
